Two faces controlled by primary caretaker; no four-clock assumption.

sources.inspection: Primary caretaker text read: four stories including clock section, sea-facing doorway with sultan monogram, restored lower140cm exposed from former ground, two repaired Zenith clocks facing land and sea. Historical lean has been corrected; upright restored2024 exterior chosen. No numeric lean inferred from conflicting translated descriptions.

Aerial inspected at close and wider zoom: square individual tower/plinth aligned northeast/southeast in open paved square between museums, water toward southeast. Coarse mapped approximately7.4m north-aligned square is generalized context and not a surveyed tower wall. Main sea-facing entrance assigned+Z southeast.

scope: Restored square clock tower: exposed plinth, paired columns, two clock faces, recessed openings, cornices, floral scroll crown and integral flagmast. Nearby mosque/museums and square fixtures excluded.
limitations: Restored2024 exterior chosen. Older2012 original controls silhouette only; unrestored clock condition/buried base not mixed into current state. Primary caretaker confirms two clock faces; fixed batch text says four and is explicitly corrected for geometry.

Map height14m and generalized7.4m square only guide coarse scale; authored masonry height15.2m, individual stage dimensions, hidden elevations and floral/monogram details are photograph-derived approximations, not surveyed. Integral black flagmast retained; cloth flag omitted.

Neighboring mosque, museums, modern sphere sculpture, surrounding square, chain security perimeter and interiors excluded. No local photographic pixels redistributed. Independent native terrain will remain unchanged; contact requires current review.
